'''Torch Industries decks''' are the constructed lists published on [[Torch Industries]] (members.aol.com/drtorch), [[Paul Todd Feldman]]'s fan site. Each list cites its Wayback copy and has a [[GEMP importable decklist|GEMP Importable deck]] download. Date is the year of the earliest Wayback capture used. A format marked (card pool) is the smallest format that fits the card pool and date.

The site also reprinted World Championship decks; those are listed on [[1997 Decipher World Championship]] and [[1999 Decipher World Championship]].

A parent index of all published 60s is [[Decklists]].
